title: Vince Dizon vows no return for dismissed corrupt LTO personnel
summary: Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon on Monday assured transport group MANIBELA that dismissed personnel of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) who were involved in corruption would not be allowed…

blocks.text: Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon on Monday assured transport group MANIBELA that dismissed personnel of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) who were involved in corruption would not be allowed to return to the agency.
According to a report by Oscar Oida on GTV’s Balitanghali, MANIBELA members gathered outside the LTO Central Office to protest the reported plan to replace LTO Assistant Secretary Marcus Lacanilao.
The group expressed concern that Lacanilao’s possible replacement could pave the way for the return of personnel allegedly involved in corruption.
MANIBELA chairperson Mar Valbuena was later invited to a meeting with Dizon and Lacanilao to discuss the group’s concerns.
Following the meeting, Dizon assured MANIBELA that dismissed corrupt LTO personnel would not be reinstated.
"Over my dead body," Dizon said when asked whether these personnel could return to the agency.
Dizon, however, said he could not confirm whether Lacanilao would remain as LTO chief, adding that the decision rests with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
Lacanilao, for his part, thanked MANIBELA for its support but said he was prepared to abide by whatever decision the Office of the President may issue regarding his position.— MCG, GMA News
